<!-- pr-reviewer: 6a8511e853db5f9f6aa9547a10628812753d5961 -->
**Independent review, #161 at 6a8511e (built and run; trial merge with origin/main was already up to date, no conflicts)**

Verdict: **Ready for the maintainer to merge.** Both earlier blockers are fixed and pinned. No build.rs, `.github/`, script or dependency changes.

### What looks good
- **B1 (suppressed cut):** `verification_report` now calls `posting_suppressed::suppressed_problems` (posting.rs:503). It walks every posted op that `reads_prior` and asks `rest::suppressed_cuts_ahead` (rest.rs:85-104) for suppressed, same-setup, actually-cutting ops ahead of it, using the same `ahead_of` walk the generator-time verdicts use. So the rest masks and the rapid/linking verdicts read the same set. `reads_prior` is conservative (Pocket3D, Drill, and every unposed op), matching the stamp digest; a posed op that reads none of it is correctly exempt. I found no remaining path where a posted op depends on a suppressed cut without the refusal. Per-op files go through `verification_report` too (posting_per_op.rs:88).
- **B2 (afterModes):** all six shipped posts that write `afterOp()` declare `afterModes = true`; the engine refuses a stop/home ask from a script without it, naming the op (engine.rs, same pattern as coolantModes). Tormach declares none, so it refuses rather than running past a stop. Heidenhain refuses Go home.
- **Merge:** `PostOptions {threading, skip_stops, per_op}` is one singleton with one `SetPostOptions` command; the loader builds all three fields in one value (project/apply.rs:491-500), old files without the new keys read as off, and default values write no key. Main's coolant, wear comp, G76, probe, C-axis and Tormach tests all still pass. Stop/home words come after M5, restorePlane and G80 (fanuc.cps afterOp after endPreamble's M5).
- No `unwrap/expect/panic` in the new modules; provenance lines present; decisions are in docs/decisions/110-pause-home.md and 111-nc-per-op.md.

### Local results (merged with main, debug)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| camcraft-post (incl. post_engine, `a_stop_asked_of_a_script_without_after_modes_is_refused_by_name`) | 9 + 33 passed, 0 failed |
| camcraft-app, 27 suites: after_op, per_op_files, suppressed_rest, posting, conformance, golden_cl, fanuc_post, lathe_post (+g76, refusals), tormach_post, coolant (+followups), wear_comp, control_comp, c_axis_live, probe_op, heidenhain_arc_centre/block_form, commands_undo, project_roundtrip, operations, remachining, setups, scripting, solid_law (+goldens) | 403 passed, 0 failed; no golden changes |
| camcraft-ui lib (CWD crates/ui) | 282 passed, 2 ignored |
| clippy `-D warnings` post/app/ui, all targets | clean |

### Requested before merge
None.

### Notes (not blocking)
- `crates/app/src/posting.rs` is 1039 lines and grew by about 50; the 400-line law says split along the seam (posting_suppressed.rs and posting_per_op.rs are already a start). A follow-up issue would do.
- `reads_prior` returning true for every unposed op means suppressing the first op of a typical setup is refused whenever any later cutting op exists. That is the safe side and the message names the way out; just worth knowing for UX.
- The PR has a `Changelog:` line, ends `Fixes #110` / `Fixes #111`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
